facts.text: The Cowboy Covenant Program provides Oklahoma's Promise recipients an additional $1,000 award per year for up to four academic years or 120 semester hours attempted.

sources.title: Cowboy Covenant | Oklahoma State University
sources.quote: The Cowboy Covenant Program helps make that possible for Oklahoma's Promise recipients by offering an additional $1,000 award per year for up to four academic years or 120 semester hours attempted (whichever occurs first).

facts.text: First-year freshmen at Oklahoma State University are required to live in university housing.

sources.title: Student Services - Oklahoma State University Catalog
sources.quote: To support student success, first-year freshmen are required to live in university housing.
